title: Doodling Dumpling Cuttlefish
statement: A thumb-sized, dumpling-round cuttlefish with ink-blue freckles draws wandering lines in pearl-white sand, then hovers over them flashing little apricot-colored squares. Its tank is a quiet turquoise grotto with one amber-lit stone arch; whenever a drawing reaches perfection, a flutter of its skirt erases everything so it can try something sillier.
